title: fix: preserve Gemini Omni provider errors
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Preserves Vertex failure details when an interaction returns no completed video.
- Allows existing content-policy handling to classify moderation refusals as 422 instead of opaque 502 errors.
- Adds a focused regression test; model and moderation suites plus typecheck pass.

Follow-up to #14083.

gist.headline: The video oracle speaks
gist.blurb: Gemini Omni video errors now arrive with their useful details intact. Polli stopped wrapping a clear moderation refusal in mysterious 502 fog.
gist.summary: Gemini Omni video generation now preserves Vertex failure details when no completed video is returned, allowing existing content-policy refusals to be correctly classified as HTTP 422 instead of opaque 502 errors.
gist.impact: Developers receive actionable Vertex and moderation error details for refused Gemini Omni video requests, with content-policy cases returning 422 responses they can handle directly.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy video-generation workstation where Polli acts as a careful error detective, reading a clear pixel terminal message from a Gemini-like crystal video orb instead of a cloud of confusing error smoke. A small code-plant and flowers reinforce that clearer errors help developers diagnose and grow their projects; Polli wears tiny detective glasses.
